network.title: Private networks
network.sub: Reach self-hosted GitLab, Jira or package registries inside your networks. A connection goes through the network whose route matches it most closely.
network.unavailable: Private networks are not set up on this server: the operator runs the gateway service and sets AGNTS_GATEWAY.
network.webhooksPolling: No webhooks: trackers reached through it are read every {n} min
network.kindHelp_connector: A small agent you run inside your network. It connects out to agnts: no VPN credentials, no inbound firewall rule, and it relays webhooks.
network.kindHelp_wireguard: agnts connects to your WireGuard peer as a client. The peer must accept UDP from this server.
network.kindHelp_openvpn: agnts runs your OpenVPN client config in an isolated container. Certificates must be inline; logins that need MFA are not supported.
network.savedConfig: Saved: {summary}. Leave empty to keep it.
network.configWgHelp: The file you would give wg-quick. Add a DNS line to reach hosts by name. Keys are encrypted and never shown again.
network.configOvpnHelp: A client config with its ca, cert and key blocks inline. Scripts (up, down, plugin…) are refused.
network.passwordKeep: Saved: leave empty to keep it
network.routesHelp: Hosts (gitlab.corp.local), domains (.corp.local) or private ranges (10.20.0.0/16) that go through this network, with ports (80 and 443 when empty). Another network may have a narrower route inside these (10.30.0.0/16 inside 10.0.0.0/8): the more specific one wins. Two networks may not list the same route.
network.blastRadius: Code agnts runs for your tickets can reach every host listed here. List exact hosts rather than whole ranges.
network.caHelp: PEM certificates of your internal CA. agnts and its runs trust them besides the public roots.
network.removeConfirm: Remove {name}? agnts will stop reaching the hosts on its routes.
network.linkHelp: Run this on a machine inside the network that can reach the hosts above. AGNTS_LINK_ALLOW is your own limit: agnts-link never dials anything else. Each network has its own token, so one machine can run several links.
network.tokenOnce: Copy it now: it is shown only once.
network.linkHooks: Webhooks: point GitLab and Jira at http://AGNTS-LINK-HOST:8080 with the same /webhooks/… path the Integrations page shows.
network.rotateConfirm: Make a new token? The running agnts-link disconnects until you restart it with the new one.
network.reconnectHelp: Restart the tunnel: a fresh OpenVPN client, a new WireGuard handshake, or agnts-link connects again
network.reconnecting: Reconnecting: the tunnel restarts within 15 seconds
network.editorSub: A tunnel into one of your networks and the hosts that go through it
network.name: Name
network.nameHelp: Unique in the workspace: the company, office or data center it reaches.
network.empty: No private networks yet. Add one to reach hosts that are only inside your network.
network.limit: A workspace keeps at most {n} private networks
network.testHelp: Enter host:port. agnts picks the network the routes lead to, connects and checks the certificate.
